---
title: "Predicting NBA home wins without leaking the future"
subtitle: "Rolling team efficiency and Elo, evaluated in time order"
toc: false
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
holdout <- readr::read_csv("outputs/holdout_metrics.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
boot <- readr::read_csv("outputs/holdout_bootstrap.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
h <- function(m) filter(holdout, model == m)
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
best <- "Ridge: rolling + Elo"
```

This project predicts whether the home team wins an NBA regular-season game,
using only information available before tip-off. Models are trained on
2001-02 through 2024-25 and tested once on the 2025-26 season
(`r format(h(best)$n, big.mark = ",")` games). Predictions for the current
season are logged daily before each game; see [Live 2026-27](live.qmd).

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
<div class="lead-number">`r pct(h(best)$accuracy)`</div>
<div class="lead-label">Holdout accuracy, ridge with rolling features + Elo</div>
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
<div class="lead-number">`r pct(h("Logistic: Elo only")$accuracy)`</div>
<div class="lead-label">Elo ratings alone</div>
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
<div class="lead-number">`r pct(h("Majority (home win rate)")$accuracy)`</div>
<div class="lead-label">Always picking the home team</div>
:::
:::

The full model beats always picking the home team by a wide margin, but Elo
ratings alone get most of the way there. The 95% bootstrap interval for the
AUC gain from adding rolling features to Elo is
`r sprintf("%.3f to %.3f", boot$auc_diff_vs_ref_low[boot$model == best], boot$auc_diff_vs_ref_high[boot$model == best])`,
which includes zero.

## All models on the holdout

```{r}
holdout |>
  left_join(boot, by = "model") |>
  arrange(desc(auc)) |>
  transmute(
    Model = model,
    Accuracy = sprintf("%.3f", accuracy),
    `Accuracy 95% CI` = sprintf("%.3f-%.3f", accuracy_low, accuracy_high),
    AUC = ifelse(is.na(auc), "-", sprintf("%.3f", auc)),
    Brier = sprintf("%.3f", brier)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = "lrrrr")
```

Code and data pipeline: [nba-modeling](https://github.com/kalebcoleman/nba-modeling)
and [nba-data](https://github.com/kalebcoleman/nba-data).
